Beyond the obvious · twice-weekly edit

Unusual London events,
this week.

Discover free and affordable things to do in London this week and weekend, selected for unusual access, local character and a story worth following. Every listing is checked against the official organiser before publication.

Friday 30 October – Sunday 1 November · Last edited 25 October at 14:59

The complete edit

5 verified events
Friday 30 October2 events
Heritage & history Free

10:00–17:00

Nazi Slave Labour: Perpetrators and Victims

On its final day, Britain's first exhibition devoted to Nazi camp slave labour draws on clandestine photographs, testimony and company records to trace both exploitation and survival.

Venue
The Wiener Holocaust Library
Address
29 Russell Square, London, WC1B 5DP
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Art & design Free

18:30–22:00

Friday Late: Phantom Constructs

A free after-hours takeover fills the V&A with eerie stagecraft, surreal screenings, algorithmic textiles, performance and study-room objects rarely placed on public display.

Venue
V&A South Kensington
Address
Cromwell Road, London, SW7 2RL
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Saturday 31 October1 event
Local culture Free event; galleries extra

12:00–17:30

Comic Day at the Cartoon Museum

A one-day comics room combines a curated sale with a 4pm seminar on collecting and trading, plus free appraisals for visitors who bring their own books.

Venue
The Cartoon Museum, Clore Learning Studio
Address
63 Wells Street, Fitzrovia, London, W1A 3AE
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Sunday 1 November2 events
Heritage & history Free to watch

07:00–08:30

London to Brighton Veteran Car Run: Hyde Park Start

At dawn, hundreds of pre-1905 cars gather on Serpentine Road and begin the world's longest-running motoring event, reviving the route of the 1896 Emancipation Run.

Venue
Hyde Park, Serpentine Road
Address
Serpentine Road, Hyde Park, London, W2 2UH
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Heritage & history Free

10:00–18:00

Beauty and Destruction: Wartime London in Art

On its final day, 45 artworks, photographs, films, objects and oral histories show how wartime artists recorded a London transformed by bombing, shortages and adaptation.

Venue
IWM London
Address
Lambeth Road, London, SE1 6HZ
Access
Drop in
